description: Compare 2 to 5 Netherlands addresses side by side, in English, for house-hunting, relocation and real estate agents: liveability, crime, home values, floor area, year built, distances to station, supermarket, school and GP, noise, air quality and ground height, plus the best address per metric and the full property report for each. Input: addresses separated by ';'. Costs $0.12 USDC via x402, or one unit of a Factline API key quota.
